decisions.reason: As the firm's highlighted flagship seasonal product with repeated gold-award recognition and a close fit to its traditional confectionery strengths, it is very unlikely to be withdrawn.
This bread remains actively presented after other new bread variants disappeared, which suggests it earned a place in the core assortment, though routine portfolio pruning still leaves some risk.

Marzipan stollen fits the firm's established holiday offer and is still promoted on its own page, so management would likely retain it as a complementary seasonal variant beside the premium raisin stollen.
